description: Forfait + tegenbewijs: d2 holdings in a year the equities return 1%, below the forfait; the actual return is taxed
source: Hand calculation with the Belastingdienst 2026 box 3 method and rounding, https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/nl/box-3/content/berekening-box-3-inkomen-2026 (tegenbewijs: https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/nl/box-3/content/wat-is-mijn-werkelijk-rendement). The Belastingdienst publishes no interactive box 3 rekenhulp; the method and rounding are checked against its own 2026 rekenvoorbeelden 1 and 3 in box3.test.ts.
derivation: Forfait as d2: voordeel 2.645, tax 952. Werkelijk rendement: equities +1% × 120.000 = 1.200, minus DUO interest 25.000 × 2,70% = 675 → 525. 525 < 2.645, so tegenbewijs applies: tax 36% × 525 = 189.
